wads.title: Valiant
wads.description: Valiant is a MBF megawad for Doom II featuring 32 new maps spanning 5 themed episodes.
wads.long_description: Valiant is a MBF megawad for Doom II featuring 32 new maps spanning 5 themed episodes. Each map is designed to be played from a pistol start, but some effort has been made to support continuous play as well.

wads.title: FLESHARMONIC
wads.description: 20 new maps, with various difficulties for DOOM II: Hell on Earth.
wads.long_description: violent and sanguinolent doom II project : Flesharmonic ! It's a 20-maps megawad of raw and grilled meat to satisfy your insatiable appetite for wads! This wad is served by the following team: @datacore (project leader), @Alephany, @Duskolos, Jambon, @Nixx and @Roofi. with the help of its fabulous testers: @Gr0mat, @WH-Wilou84 and its talented artist : @franckFRAG
wads.authors: Datacore, Alephany, Jambon, Nixx, Duskolos, Roofi

wads.title: Survive in Hell (RC2)
wads.description: Survive in Hell is a set 33 Boom compatible maps.
wads.long_description: Survive in Hell (SIH) is a Boom compatible WAD featuring 33 new levels and new custom monsters. SIH offers fun and fast paced action in a copycastesque environment. Blast through new landscapes of hell and twisted scenery to earn your freedom.

wads.title: L'Agonie Finale
wads.description: L'Agonie Finale is a final bonus level bringing a closure to the 3 Heures d'Agonie series
wads.long_description: L'Agonie Finale is the ultimate level in the 3HA series. A center HUB connecting multiple parallel worlds created by various authors of the series will be your playground. Each section has been built under a 3-hour time limit.
wads.authors: [WH]-Wilou84, Jambon, franckFRAG, Roofi, JCD, Oxyde, Datacore85

wads.title: 3 Heures d'Agonie III
wads.description: 3 Heures d'Agonie is a 32-level Megawad created by the Doom French Community.
wads.long_description: 3 Heures d'Agonie (English: 3 Hours of Agony) is a 32-level megawad for limit-removing source ports, created by members of the French Doom community. Each map in the WAD was made within a three hour time limit, though the concept differs from traditional speedmapping events in that there was no singular mapping period, allowing participants to create multiple levels.
wads.authors: franckFRAG, Roofi, Jambon, NilstheRed, Necrotikflesh, Datacore, Oxyde, Memfis, JCD, [WH]-Wilou84, Ch0wW, Darkwave000
